Ye.question: Analyze the multi-dimensional challenges in achieving India's Green Hydrogen Mission targets by 2030. Suggest pragmatic measures to build a resilient domestic ecosystem. (GS-3, 15 Marks, 250 Words)

breakdown.feedback: Strong reference to National Green Hydrogen Mission target (5 MMT by 2030) and SIGHT programme. Good opening.

Well structured across 4 pillars: Electrolyzer capex dependency (rare earths), high renewable power transmission tariffs, fresh water availability for electrolysis, and safety/transportation storage hazards.
Excellent recommendation of Viability Gap Funding (VGF), indigenous PEM & AEM electrolyzer PLI schemes, coastal desalination coupling, and green hydrogen blended city gas distribution.
Missing schematic flowchart! Recommended drawing: Renewable Power -> Desalination -> Electrolyzer Hub -> Fertilizer/Refinery demand clustering.

recommendedKeywords: Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT)
upscZoneAiEvaluation.modelAnswerStructure: 1. Definition & 5 MMT Target -> 2. Economic & Technological Bottlenecks -> 3. Resource Constraints (Water, RE Wheeling) -> 4. International Standards & Export Readiness -> 5. Strategic 5-Point Roadmap

competitorFeedback.traditionalCoaching: Checked after 16 days. Evaluator wrote: 'Good points. Elaborate more on technology. Work on handwriting. Marks: 5/15' (No model structure, no missing keywords listed, no prompt turnaround).
competitorFeedback.genericAi: Generated in 4 seconds. Said: 'Fascinating essay! Green hydrogen is great for climate change. You wrote nicely. You can add more about solar energy. Score: 8/10' (Hallucinates generic praise, US spelling, misses 15-mark UPSC rubric).
competitorFeedback.aiStartups: Said: 'Nice answer. Intro has good facts. Add more points in body.' (Gives no specific committee names, no SIGHT scheme breakdown, no flowchart recommendation).
